Exam Date & Time: 22-May-2023 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - MAY/JUNE 2023  
  SUBJECT: HUM 1071-PHY/HUM 1051-B/HUM 1071-B - COMMUNICATION SKILLS IN  
  ENGLISH  
  COMMUNICATION SKILLS IN ENGLISH [HUM 1071-PHY]  
Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          He has been a teetotaller _____ three years, and he _____ alcohol since then.  
  a. for / hasn't touched  
  b. since / doesn't touch                                                                (1)  
  c. for / isn't touching  
  
1B)          The NCC officer _____ a voluntary trek every Saturday to nearby tourist spots to clear  
  the area of litter.  
  a. is arranging                                                                            (1)  
  b. had arranged  
  c. arranges  
  
1C)          _____ honest worker is certainly _____ asset to any organization.  
  a. a; an  
  b. an; an                                                                                  (1)  
  c. an, the  
  
1D)          Just yesterday, the Advisory board _____ to restructure _____ policy for admissions.  
  a. have decided; their  
  b. has decided; its                                                                        (1)  
  c. decided; its  
  
1E)          Everyone _____ to abide by the rules of game and may _____ team win.  
  a. have agreed, a best  
  b. has agreed, the best                                                                    (1)  
  c. are agreeing, best  
  
1F)          Identify the grammatically correct sentence out of the following:  
  a. Neither the umpire nor the coach is aware of the changed regulations.  
  b. Neither the umpire nor the coach are aware of the changed regulations.                  (1)  
  c. Neither the umpire nor the coach have been aware of the changed regulations  
  
1G)          Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?  
  a. The prisoner confessed that he committed a heinous crime  
  b. The prisoner confessed that he had committed a heinous crime                            (1)  
  c. The prisoner had confessed that he had committed a heinous crime  
  
1H)          Choose the grammatically correct sentence:                                                 (1)  
  a. The class topper as well as her friends find it hard to cope with the end semester  
  examinations  
  b. The class topper as well as her friends find it hard to cope up with the end semester  
  examinations

c. The class topper as well as her friends finds it hard to cope with the end semester  
  examinations  
  
1I)           Choose the grammatically correct sentence:  
  a. One of the main concern of the students is the efficient use of Exam pad  
  b. One of the main concerns of the students are the efficient use of Exam pad                 (1)  
  c. One of the main concerns of the students is the efficient use of Exam pad  
  
1J)           Choose the grammatically correct sentence:  
  a. Neither of his friend turned up for the event, so it ended up as a one-man show  
  b. Neither of his friend turned up for the event, so it ended up as an one-man show           (1)  
  c. Neither of his friends turned up for the event, so it ended up as a one-man show  
  
  B  
Answer all the questions.  
Answer the following question in about 350- 400 words:  
2)           Soil Not Oil proposes a solution based on self-organization, sustainability and  
  community rather than corporate power and profits. Do you agree with the above  
  statement? Substantiate your answer with reference to the text you have discussed in           (10)  
  class.  
  
3)            Yuval Noah Harari claims that once algorithms know you better than you know yourself,  
  they could control and manipulate you, and you won't be able to do much about it.  
  Do you think Harari is justified in making this claim? Substantiate your answer with  (10)  
  reference to the text.  
  
4)            Read the following passage and provide a response to the question in about 300-350 (10)  
  words. Your response is required to show a critical understanding of the ideas  
  presented in the passage.  
  
  Every moment of life is precious. Time is the essence of life. It is the wealth given to us  
  by Nature. Everyday all of us get 24 hours; nothing less, nothing more. Now, it is up to  
  us how we use it. People who know how to make the best use of every moment easily  
  open the doors of success in their lives and those who misuse time get failures one after  
  the other. There is a saying that, ''Spent time and spent words cannot come back.''  
  Everybody is tied by the limits of time; even God respects the boundaries of time.  
  Work wins appreciation only when it gets completed in a requisite time frame. Beyond  
  the time allotted, work loses all its utility however good may have been its quality. Just  
  as falling of rains after the crops have dried up have no use; likewise, when the time is  
  past the deadline, the work loses its importance and value. When iron is hot it can be  
  cast into whichever shape we want. Once it gets cold nothing can be made out of it,  
  however, much we may beat the same. In the same way, a person who has learnt to  
  wisely use his time and has understood how to cast himself according to the need of the  
  time has actually learnt the true mantra of life.  
  Shakespeare wrote in one of his plays, ''I wasted time, and now doth time waste me.'' It  
  is true that a person who wastes even a little bit of time loses wonderful opportunities  
  that he could have otherwise availed of by utilizing that time. All the great leaders have  
  one thing in common. They wisely utilize every moment of their time. When other  
  people are busy in wasting time in laziness, great men are busy in making plans for the  
  future. There is no person in history who wasted his time and still managed to achieve  
  greatness.  
  Therefore, there is great need to manage time wisely. ''Careful Time Management'' refers  
  to careful planning of time and sincere execution of this plan. This is the only mantra to  
  attain success in any endeavour. A simple change in outlook and some modification in  
  one's daily routine can result in a big jump forward towards greater achievements.  
  (Source: https://www.vsajaipur.com/laravel/public/e-class/5e9f0ce2c02b5.pdf)  
  Question:

A simple shift in attitude and a few changes to one's daily routine can lead to a big  
  step forward toward bigger goals. Do you share the author's perspective?  
  
  C  
Answer 1 out of 2 questions.  
Write an essay on ANY ONE of the following topics in about 600 words.  
5A)          The Future of Space Exploration.  
  (10)  
  
5B)             Are our Traditions hindering our Progress?  
  (10)  
  
-----End-----
